name: bafu-finding
description: A measured observation about a BAFU/UVEK dataset or release (not a contribution layer)

name: bug
description: Something isn't working

name: discussion
description: A question or decision about the data, a method difference, or how a finding goes upstream

name: documentation
description: Improvements or additions to documentation

name: duplicate
description: This issue or pull request already exists

name: enhancement
description: New feature or request

name: good first issue
description: Good for newcomers

name: handled-in-layer
description: A contribution layer applies it in a candidate build; the upstream question stays open

name: help wanted
description: Extra attention is needed

name: informational
description: A method or scope difference, not a defect

name: invalid
description: This doesn't seem right

name: licence
description: Terms of Use, redistribution, attribution

name: needs-info
description: Missing evidence or clarification prevents implementation

name: needs-triage
description: Not yet re-measured by a second person

name: question
description: Further information is requested

name: ready-for-agent
description: Bounded implementation task with no remaining declared blockers

name: ready-for-human
description: Human work or decision is required

name: upstream-fixed
description: BAFU corrected it in a named release

name: upstream-reported
description: Sent to lca@bafu.admin.ch (date on the issue)

name: withdrawn
description: Did not survive re-measurement against BAFU's own files; kept so nobody re-finds it

name: wontfix
description: This will not be worked on
